scenarios: no registered tool schema declares a secret-shaped field and a call carrying a custody value is refused before policy
a guest reaches a credentialed service by injection while its environment, its output and the policy it was built from never carry the value
every grant is short-lived, expires by dropping the secret, and is renewed rather than standing
an external server that repeats a custody secret back has it redacted before the answer leaves the host
proof: both halves are proven against real substrates — the whole registered tool surface for the argument rule, and every sandbox backend's conformance contract for the handle.
audit: IMP-EV-0215 sealed at 4302fda; IMP-EV-0288 sealed with this milestone.
limitations: the Core's own provider and forge credentials are custody-held rather than short-lived; redaction of a returned secret is substring matching, backed by controls that do not depend on it; renewal re-sends rather than rotates.
ci: main CI green on macOS, Linux and Windows (run 35391720594)
